adds.rationale: Oklo's May 2024 NYSE listing gives the portfolio its first direct pure-play on the fission/SMR wave named as the fourth likely next-wave in the thesis, a bucket currently at zero exposure, and its fast-fission microreactor design plus Sam Altman-chaired board tie it directly to the AI-datacenter power-demand narrative.

removes.rationale: BOTZ's own SEC-filed holdings composition shows its largest weights are legacy industrial-automation names (ABB, Keyence, Fanuc) plus NVIDIA, which the watchlist already owns directly, so the ETF is delivering diluted, partly redundant exposure rather than a distinct forward-looking bet on the still-nascent humanoid/next-gen robotics wave.

news_evidence.summary: Global X Funds regulatory filing amendment confirms BOTZ's top holdings are ABB, Keyence, Fanuc, NVIDIA and Intuitive Surgical -- legacy industrial-automation names plus a mega-cap AI chipmaker already held directly

rationale_overall: Net effect: swap a diffuse, NVDA-overlapping industrial-robotics ETF for a direct pure-play on the nuclear/SMR wave, the one technology wave named in the thesis that had zero representation going into this rebalance. Everything else stays put on solid Q1-2024 evidence: RKLB (record Q1 revenue, Neutron progress), ASTS (AT&T definitive commercial deal signed May 2024), LUNR (Q1 revenue beat), FRO (Red-Sea-driven VLCC rate strength), WELL (Q1 NOI and occupancy surge), ITA (steady defense-spending tailwind), IONQ (continued revenue growth, extended AWS Braket deal), and the AI core MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA/SPY. Robotics exposure isn't abandoned -- NVDA already captures the AI-robotics intersection -- while nuclear now has its first foothold ahead of AI-driven baseload demand.
